children: Woodford Glen will feature estate homes on one-acre home sites in a serene cul-de-sac setting
, the nation's leading builder of luxury homes, today announced its newest community,

, is coming soon to Horsham, Pennsylvania. This exclusive Montgomery County community will feature only 22 luxury single-family homes on expansive, one-acre home sites in a tranquil cul-de-sac setting. Site work is underway at 1 Bloomfield Lane in Horsham, and sales are anticipated to begin in late fall 2026.

Woodford Glen will feature home sites averaging more than an acre and exquisite home designs with approximately 4,600 to more than 6,600 square feet of living space. Each home showcases 4 to 5 bedrooms, 4 to 6 baths, large primary bedroom suites, first-floor bedroom suites, expansive open-concept great rooms, chef-inspired kitchens, and side-entry garages. Finished basements, lofts, and outdoor living spaces are also available. Homes in Woodford Glen are anticipated to be priced from $1.6 million.

Toll Brothers customers will experience one-stop shopping at the Toll Brothers Design Studio. The state-of-the-art Design Studio allows home shoppers to choose from a wide array of selections to personalize their dream home with the assistance of Toll Brothers professional Design Consultants.

"We are thrilled to introduce Woodford Glen, with its grand homes and expansive tree-lined yards, to home shoppers in the Horsham area," said John Dean, Division President of Toll Brothers in Pennsylvania. "This intimate community offers a rare opportunity to own a luxury estate home in a quiet and picturesque cul-de-sac setting, with spacious home sites and thoughtfully designed floor plans that cater to modern lifestyles."

Located near major commuter routes, including Routes 611, 202, 309, and the Pennsylvania Turnpike, Woodford Glen provides convenient access to nearby shopping, dining, and entertainment options in Warrington, Ambler, Montgomeryville, and Doylestown. The community is also close to several parks and golf courses, offering an array of opportunities for outdoor recreation. Students living in Woodford Glen have the opportunity to attend schools in the highly regarded Hatboro-Horsham School District or one of the many award-winning private schools nearby.
For more information and to join the Toll Brothers interest list for Woodford Glen, call (855) 872-8205 or visit TollBrothers.com/PA.

Toll Brothers, Inc., a Fortune 500 Company, is the nation's leading builder of luxury homes. The Company was founded in 1967 and became a public company in 1986 with common stock listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol "TOL." Toll Brothers builds new homes and communities in over 60 markets across the United States, serving first-time, move-up, active-adult, and second-home buyers. The Company also operates its own architectural, engineering, mortgage, title, land development, smart home technology, landscape, and building components manufacturing businesses.

Toll Brothers was named the #1 Most Admired Home Builder in Fortune magazine's 2026 list of the World's Most Admired Companies®, the ninth year the Company has achieved this honor. Toll Brothers has also been named Builder of the Year by Builder magazine and is the first two-time recipient of Builder of the Year from Professional Builder magazine. For more information visit TollBrothers.com.
